She added Mushrooms that weighed 100 grams and olives which weighed 50 grams. Meanwhile, Bella decided to eat a Pepperoni pizza which weighed 354 grams, but she also added some toppings to her pizza. She added Extra cheese weighing 75 grams and onions weighing 55 grams. How many grams of pizza did Rachel and Bella eat in total in Naples?

Given integers \(x, y, z\) that satisfy the equations
\[
4x - 5y + 24z = 4A
\]
\[
2x - 2y + 2z = 10
\]
with the conditions \(y < 2x\) and \(y - 20z < 0\), find the largest value of the natural number \(A\).

Define a sequence \((a_n)\) recursively by setting \(a_0 = 1\), \(a_1 = \sqrt[17]{3}\), and for \(n \geq 2\), \(a_n = a_{n-1}^3 a_{n-2}^2\). Determine the smallest positive integer \(k\) such that the product \(a_1a_2\cdots a_k\) is an integer.

After being contracted to build 4000 bollards on each side of a road, a company was only able to install π/4 of the total number of bollards required on all sides of the road. How many more bollards are they required to install on all sides of the remaining part of the road?
Let \( a, b, c \geq 0 \) and \( a (1-a)(2-b)(2-c) \ge \frac{1}{4} \). Find the minimum value of \( ab + bc + ca \).

A train crosses a platform of 170 m in 15 sec. The same train crosses another platform of length 250 m in a certain amount of time. The length of the train is 70 m. How long does it take for the train to cross the second platform?
A group of students decided to collect as many paise from each member of the group as is the number of members. If the total collection amounts to Rs. 59.29, how many members are in the group?

A contractor hires a man, a woman, and two teenagers to complete a construction project. The man can complete the work in 10 days, the woman in 12 days, and the teenagers can each finish the project in 15 days if they worked individually. The contractor wants to finish the work in 5 days and decides to pay each of them according to their contribution in the project. If he pays a total of 6000 dollars for the completed project, how much will each person receive from the contractor?

Solve the following equation with real numbers:

$$
\log _{19}(x-3)+\log _{93}(x-3)=3-\lg \left(x^{5}-24\right)
$$

I bought a lottery ticket, the sum of the digits of its five-digit number turned out to be equal to the age of my neighbor. Determine the number of the ticket, given that my neighbor easily solved this problem.

A football team shares a single water cooler during practice.  During practice, linemen get the first water break and will drink 8 ounces each.  Skill position players get the second water break and drink 6 ounces each.  The team has 12 linemen and 10 skill position players.  If the cooler holds 126 ounces of water, how many skill position players must wait for the cooler to be refilled before they can get a drink?

Bruce recently had a birthday. His aunt sent him a card with $75 and his grandfather sent him a card that had $150 in it. He wants to go on a trip to Europe soon, so he decides to put one-fifth of the money he got for his birthday in the bank. How much money did he put in the bank?

Running at their respective constant rate, machine X takes some days longer to produce W widgets than machine Y. At these rates, if the two machines together produce 5W/4 widgets in 3 days, it would take machine X alone 18 days to produce 3W widgets. How many days longer does machine X take to produce W widgets than machine Y?
Suppose that $4$ is a factor of $b$, $b$ is a divisor of $24$, and $b$ is positive. What is the number of possible values of $b$?
If (1/5)^35 * (1/4)^18 = 1/(some number*(10)^35), then n = 35. What is the number?

A Burmese python that was 1.4 meters long swallowed a 50-centimeter alligator.  After one week, the alligator was completely digested.  If this snake continues to eat 50-centimeter-long alligators at a constant rate of one alligator per week, what is the maximum number of alligators that the snake can eat in 616 days?

A car's brakes are applied, and it travels 10 feet less in each second than the previous second until it comes to a complete stop. The car travels 40 feet in the first second after the brakes are applied. How many feet does the car travel from the time the brakes are applied to the time the car stops?
A shopkeeper sells 400 meters of cloth for Rs. 18,000 at a loss of Rs. 5 per meter. What is his cost price for one meter of cloth?

Let \( n > 1 \). Consider \( S_n \) as the permutation group over \( \{1, \ldots, n\} \) and \( H \) a subgroup of \( S_n \). Suppose that for every \( i, j \in \{1, \ldots, n\} \) there is a \( g \in H \) such that \( g(i) = j \). Find the number of permutations \( h \in H \) such that \( h(i) \neq i \) for all \( 1 \le i \le n \), given that \( n = 5 \).
What is the sum of all values of \( x \) for which \( \sqrt{(x-2)^2} = 9 \)?

The ages of Patrick and Michael are in the ratio of 3 : 5, and that of Michael and Monica are in the ratio of 3 : 5. If the sum of their ages is 245, what is the difference between the ages of Patrick and Monica?
Determine the value of $\frac{1}{\sin 10^{\circ}} - \frac{\sqrt{3}}{\sin 80^{\circ}}$.

Cindy wishes to arrange her coins into $X$ piles, each consisting of the same number of coins, $Y$. Each pile will have more than one coin and no pile will have all the coins. If there are 13 possible values for $Y$ given all of the restrictions, what is the smallest number of coins she could have?

For positive integers $n,$ let $\tau(n)$ denote the number of positive integer divisors of $n,$ including 1 and $n.$ Define $S(n)$ by $S(n)=\tau(1)+ \tau(2) + \cdots + \tau(n).$ Let $a$ denote the number of positive integers $n \leq 2500$ with $S(n)$ odd, and let $b$ denote the number of positive integers $n \leq 2500$ with $S(n)$ even. Find $|a-b|.$

Abigail, Beatrice, and Carson combine their eggs to sell them at the market. If Abigail has 42 eggs, Beatrice has 53 eggs, and Carson has 19 eggs, and if eggs can only be sold in cartons of 15, how many eggs will be left over if all cartons are sold?

In right-angled $\triangle ABC$ with the right angle at vertex $C$, let $D$ be the foot of the altitude from $C$, and let $k$ be a circle that touches $BD$ at $E$, $CD$ at $F$, and the circumcircle of $\triangle ABC$ at $G$. If $AF = 5$ and $FG = 12$, find the length of $AG$.
David obtained some marks in English, 35 in Mathematics, 52 in Physics, 47 in Chemistry, and 55 in Biology. His average marks are 46.8. What are his marks in English?

For any positive integer \( n \), let \( a_n \) be the real number solution of \( x^3 + \frac{x}{n} = 1 \). Calculate the value of \( n \) such that \( \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{1}{(i+1)^2 a_i} = \frac{1}{2} a_n \).

The Sweet Shop gets a new candy shipment every 35 days. There are some cases of chocolate bars and 55 cases of lollipops, making a total of 80 cases of candy. How many cases of chocolate bars are there?

Let $d_1 = a^2 + 2^a + a \cdot 2^{(a+1)/2}$ and $d_2 = a^2 + 2^a - a \cdot 2^{(a+1)/2}$. If $1 \le a \le 251$, how many integral values of $a$ are there such that $d_1 \cdot d_2$ is a multiple of $5$?
The manufacturing cost of a shoe is some amount, and the transportation cost is Rs. 500 for 100 shoes. The selling price is Rs. 246 with a 20% gain. What is the manufacturing cost of a shoe?

Jia and Yi went to a discount store to buy goods. It is known that the number of items they bought is equal, and the unit price of each item is only 8 yuan or 9 yuan. If the total cost of the goods they bought was 172 yuan, then the number of items priced at 9 yuan is ____.
Consider the equation \[\frac{x^2}{49} - \frac{(y-3)^2}{25} = 0.\] This describes a degenerate hyperbola. What is the largest possible $y$-coordinate of any point on the graph of this equation?
Calculate the number of ways in which 4 boys and 2 girls can stand in a row such that the 2 girls are not adjacent to each other.

Find all positive integers $n$ such that it is possible to partition the set $\{1,2,...,3n\}$ into $n$ $3$-element subsets $\{a,b,c\}$ in which $b-a$ and $c-b$ are different numbers from the set $\{n-1,n,n+1\}$.
A sea turtle claims that the hidden treasure map he found is $7324_8$ years old. How old is the map in base ten?

In a race of 250 meters, competitor A covers the distance in 40 seconds, competitor B in 50 seconds, and competitor C in 55 seconds. Determine by how much competitor A beats competitors B and C, and find the time difference between B and C at the finish line.

Point $P$ is inside a regular octagon $A_1A_2A_3A_4A_5A_6A_7A_8$. There exist lines $\ell_1$, $\ell_2$, $\ldots$, $\ell_8$ (not necessarily distinct) that intersect at $P$ such that $\ell_i \perp \overline{A_iA_{i+1}}$ for $i = 1, 2, \ldots, 7$ and $\ell_8 \perp \overline{A_8A_1}$. What is the ratio $\frac{[LP]}{[A_1A_2A_3A_4A_5A_6A_7A_8]}$, where $[LP]$ denotes the area of the locus of $P$ and $[A_1A_2A_3A_4A_5A_6A_7A_8]$ denotes the area of the octagon?

An ant lies on each corner of a  $20 \times 23$  rectangle. Each second, each ant independently and randomly chooses to move one unit vertically or horizontally away from its corner. After  $10$  seconds, find the expected area of the convex quadrilateral whose vertices are the positions of the ants.

Thirty pieces of tissue, each 25 centimeters (cm) long, were overlapped by 6 centimeters (cm) and attached in a long line. Find the total length in centimeters (cm) of 30 pieces of toilet paper attached.

Let \(a\), \(b\), \(c\), \(d\) be real numbers satisfying
\[
(a + c)(b + d) = \sqrt{2}(ac - 2bd - 1).
\]
Find the minimum value of the expression
\[
(ab - 1)^2 + (bc - 1)^2 + (cd - 1)^2 + (da - 1)^2 + (ac - 1)^2 + (2bd + 1)^2.
\]

Consider a space where each point is painted in one of two colors. Define a tetrahedron as valid if all its vertices and its centroid are of the same color. Let $N$ be the minimum number of points required to guarantee the existence of at least one valid tetrahedron. Find $N$.

Point \( P \) lies in the interior of the acute triangle \( ABC \). If \(\angle BPC = 180^\circ - \angle A\), \(\angle CPA = 180^\circ - \angle B\), and \(\angle APB = 180^\circ - \angle C\), find the sum of the distances from \( P \) to the sides \( AB \), \( BC \), and \( CA \) if the area of triangle \( ABC \) is 30 square units and the semiperimeter is 15 units.
How many diagonals does a convex polygon with 25 sides have?

In a soccer match, based on the attacking and defending situation on the field, the goalkeeper will move back and forth in front of the goal. If we take the goal line as the reference, moving forward is recorded as a positive number, and moving backward is recorded as a negative number. The movement record of a goalkeeper during a period of time is as follows (unit: $m): +7, -3, +8, +4, -6, -8, +14, -15. (Assume that the timing starts when the goalkeeper is exactly on the goal line)
(1) Does the goalkeeper return to the goal line at the end?
(2) Assuming the goalkeeper consumes 0.1 calories of energy for every 1 meter run, how many calories of energy did the goalkeeper consume during this period?
(3) If the goalkeeper is more than 10m away from the goal line (excluding 10m), the opponent's player is highly likely to score a goal with a lob shot. How many opportunities does the opponent's player have to score a goal with a lob shot during this period? Briefly explain the reason.

There are 8 stores in town that had a total of 21 visitors on a particular day. However, only some people went shopping that day; some people visited more than one store. If 8 people visited exactly two stores each, and everyone visited at least one store, what is the largest number of stores anyone could have visited? How many people went shopping that day?
The edges of a cuboid are some cm, 5 cm, and 6 cm. The volume of the cuboid is 120 cm³. What is the length of the first edge?
When plotted in the standard rectangular coordinate system, trapezoid $ABCD$ has vertices $A(1, -2)$, $B(1, 1)$, $C(5, 7)$ and $D(5, 1)$. What is the area of trapezoid $ABCD$?
In a rectangular coordinate system, what is the number of units in the distance from the origin to the point $(20, 21)$?
For positive real numbers \(a\), \(b\), and \(c\), let \(f(a, b, c) = \sqrt[3]{\frac{a}{2b+25c}} + \sqrt[3]{\frac{b}{2c+25a}} + \sqrt[3]{\frac{c}{2a+25b}}\). Find the minimum value of \(f(a, b, c)\).
There are 95 students in both first and second year classes. If there are 32 first graders, how many more sophomores are there than first graders?
How many ways can 2210 be factored as a product of a two-digit number and a three-digit number? (Two factorizations of the form $a \cdot b$ and $b \cdot a$ are considered the same.)

Find the number of ordered triples of nonnegative integers \((a, b, c)\) that satisfy
\[
(a b+1)(b c+1)(c a+1)=84.
\]

Consider a sequence \(a_1 \in \mathbb{N}\) and \(10a_n \leq a_{n+1} \leq 10a_n + 9\). Define \(f(n)\) as the number of composite numbers in the first \(n\) terms of the sequence. Find the smallest value of \(n\) such that \(f(n) \geq 10\).
There are 25 results with an average of 18. The average of the first 12 of them is a certain value and that of the last 12 is 20. The 13th result is 90. What is the average of the first 12 results?
For how many integer values of $n$ between 1 and 499 inclusive does the decimal representation of $\frac{n}{500}$ terminate?

Consider the set of numbers of the form \(2^a 3^b\) where \(a\) and \(b\) are integers with \(b \geq 0\). Let \(x\) be a real number. Define \(d(x)\) as the minimum value of \(|x - 2^a 3^b|\) over all integers \(a\) and \(b\) with \(b \geq 0\). Calculate the smallest possible value of \(d(100)\).

Group the set of positive even numbers $\{2, 4, 6, \cdots\}$ in increasing order such that the $n$-th group contains $3n-2$ numbers:
$$
\{2\}, \{4, 6, 8, 10\}, \{12, 14, \cdots, 24\}, \cdots .
$$

Which group does the number 2018 belong to?
If 5 / w plus some fraction = 5 / y and wx = y, then the average (arithmetic mean) of w and x is 0.5. What is the fraction?

Amaya is watching a movie that she finds kind of boring, so she keeps tuning out and having to rewind it to catch what she missed. She watches 35 minutes before she realizes she needs to rewind the movie to catch something she missed, a process that adds 5 minutes to her total viewing time. She watches the movie for some minutes but has to rewind it again, adding 15 minutes to her total time. Finally, she watches the last 20 minutes uninterrupted. It took her 120 minutes to watch the movie including rewinds and re-watching parts. How many minutes did she watch before the second rewind?

In triangle \(ABC\), let a circle through \(B\) and \(C\) intersect \(AB\) and \(AC\) at \(Y\) and \(Z\), respectively. Let \(P\) be the intersection of \(BZ\) and \(CY\), and let \(X\) be the intersection of \(AP\) and \(BC\). Let \(M\) be the point distinct from \(X\) on the intersection of the circumcircle of triangle \(XYZ\) with \(BC\). If \(BC = 14\), calculate the length of \(BM\).
Kiarra is a certain age, and Bea is younger than her. Job is 3 times older than Bea. Figaro is 7 years older than Job. Harry is half as old as Figaro. If Kiarra is 30, how old is Bea?
How many odd numbers are greater than 215 and less than 500?

Let $\triangle ABC$ be a sharp-angled triangle with orthocenter $H$. The external bisector of $\angle BHC$ intersects $AB$ and $AC$ at points $D$ and $E$, respectively. The internal bisector of $\angle BAC$ intersects the circumcircle of $\triangle ADE$ at point $K$. If $HK$ intersects $BC$ at point $M$, calculate the ratio $\frac{BM}{MC}$.

There are some men in a race. 1/4 of the men tripped and were unable to finish. 2/3 of the remaining men were dehydrated and 1/5 of those dehydrated men couldn't finish the race. 52 men finished the race. How many men were in the race initially?

Let \(a, b, c > 0\) and \(abc = 1\). Find the minimum value of the expression
\[
\frac{a}{b} + \frac{b}{c} + \frac{c}{a} - \frac{3}{2\sqrt[3]{2}} \left(a + \frac{1}{b}\right).
\]

The stem-and-leaf plot shows the duration of one lap in minutes and seconds for each of the $15$ fastest cars in a race. In the stem-and-leaf plot, $1 \ 15$ represents $1$ minute, $15$ seconds, which is equivalent to $75$ seconds. Determine the median duration of these laps. Express your answer in seconds.

\begin{tabular}{c|ccccc}
0&45&48&50&&\\
1&10&15&20&30&45\\
2&05&10&15&20&25\\
3&10&15&&&\\
\end{tabular}
In a triangle \(ABC\), given that \((\sin A - \cos A)(\sin B - \cos B)(\sin C - \cos C) = 1\), find the value of \(\cot A + \cot B + \cot C\).
How many obtuse interior angles are possible in a convex quadrilateral?
Let set $\mathcal{C}$ be a 70-element subset of $\{1,2,3,\ldots,120\}$, and let $U$ be the sum of the elements of $\mathcal{C}$. Find the number of possible values of $U$.
The sum of 49 consecutive integers is $7^5$. What is their median?

According to national regulations, the weight of a certain type of rice (unit: kg) must follow a normal distribution $\xi \sim N(10, \sigma^2)$. Based on the test results, it is known that $P(9.9 \leq \xi \leq 10.1) = 0.96$. If a company purchases a bag of this packaged rice as a welfare benefit for each of its 2000 employees, the number of employees who receive rice weighing less than 9.9kg is approximately \_\_\_\_\_\_.
The dilation, centered at $1 + 2i,$ with scale factor 2, takes $2 + i$ to which complex number?
Let \(\Theta(x) = \sum \log p\), where the sum is taken over all primes \(p \leq x\). Calculate the value of \(\left\lfloor \frac{\Theta(1000)}{\log 4} \right\rfloor\).

Given a pyramid \( SABCD \) with its side faces touching a sphere \( \omega \), and the face \( ABCD \) intersects this sphere, where the center of \( \omega \) lies inside the pyramid. Let \( S' \ne S \) be a point such that the side faces of the pyramid \( S'ABCD \) also touch the sphere \( \omega \). Calculate the ratio of the volume of pyramid \( SABCD \) to the volume of pyramid \( S'ABCD \) if \( S' \) is the reflection of \( S \) over the center of the sphere \( \omega \).

Line \( l_{1} \) passes through point \( P(3,2) \) and has an inclination angle of \( \arctan \frac{3}{4} \). If \( l_{1} \) intersects line \( l_{2}: x-2y+11=0 \) at point \( Q \), find the distance \( |PQ| \).

Define the sequence $\left\{a_{n}\right\}$ such that $a_{n}$ is the last digit of the sum $1 + 2 + \cdots + n$. Let $S_{n}$ be the sum of the first $n$ terms of the sequence $\left\{a_{n}\right\}$. Find $S_{2016}$.

Let \(X_1\), \(Z_2\), \(Y_1\), \(X_2\), \(Z_1\), \(Y_2\) be six points lying on the periphery of a circle (in this order). Let the chords \(Y_1Y_2\) and \(Z_1Z_2\) meet at a point \(A\); let the chords \(Z_1Z_2\) and \(X_1X_2\) meet at a point \(B\); let the chords \(X_1X_2\) and \(Y_1Y_2\) meet at a point \(C\). Calculate the value of the expression

\[
\left( BX_2 - CX_1 \right) \cdot BC + \left( CY_2 - AY_1 \right) \cdot CA + \left( AZ_2 - BZ_1 \right) \cdot AB.
\]
Find the remainder when the number \( N = 1222233333333344...... \) (up to 1000 digits) is divided by 99.

For any four-digit number $m=\overline{abcd}$, if $a \lt b \lt c \lt d$ and $a+d=b+c$, then the number $m$ is called a "rising number". If we exchange the digit in the thousand's place and the digit in the ten's place of $m$ to get a new number $m'$, let $F(m)=\frac{m'-m}{99}$. Find $F\left(2457\right)$; Given $P=\overline{1xyz}$ and $Q=\overline{xt6z}$ are both "rising numbers", and $F\left(P\right)+F\left(Q\right)$ is a multiple of $7$, find the value of $Q$.

On the extensions of the sides \(AB\), \(BC\), \(CD\) and \(DA\) of a convex quadrilateral \(ABCD\), points \(B_1\), \(C_1\), \(D_1\), and \(A_1\) are taken respectively, such that \(BB_1 = AB\), \(CC_1 = BC\), \(DD_1 = CD\), and \(AA_1 = DA\). By how many times is the area of quadrilateral \(ABCD\) smaller than the area of quadrilateral \(A_1 B_1 C_1 D_1\)? (10 points)
Given a function $f(x + y) = f(x) + f(y) + 2xy$ where $x, y \in \mathbb{R}$, and given that $f(1) = 2$, find $f(-3)$.
Real numbers $x$ and $y$ satisfy the equation $2x^2 + 2y^2 = 20x - 12y + 68$. What is $x+y$?
Ravi covers a distance of 900 meters in 180 seconds. What is his speed in kmph?

Consider a plane divided into sectors by lines such that no two lines are parallel and no point belongs to more than two lines. Assign a positive number to each sector such that for every line, the sum of the numbers on both sides of the line are equal. If there are 5 lines dividing the plane, find the sum of all possible distinct values of the number assigned to a specific sector.

Wallace runs a beef jerky company. The company dries the jerky low and slow, so one batch of jerky takes all night to make. Each batch can make a certain number of bags of jerky. Wallace received a customer order for 60 bags of jerky, and he has 20 bags of jerky already made. It will take him 4 days to fulfill the customer's order. How many bags of jerky can one batch make?

Let \( A \) be the set of real solutions of the equation \( 3^x = x + 2 \), and let \( B \) be the set of real solutions of the equation \( \log_3 (x+2) + \log_2 (3^x - x) = 3^x - 1 \). Calculate the sum of all elements in \( B \) that are irrational.

Given the set $T$ of all positive divisors of $2004^{100}$, determine the maximum possible number of elements in a subset $S$ of $T$ such that no element of $S$ is a multiple of any other element in $S$.

Let $\Gamma_1$ and $\Gamma_2$ be two non-intersecting circles with centers $O_1$ and $O_2$ respectively, and denote by $l_1$ and $l_2$ their external common tangents. Take a point $A$ on $l_1$ (on the segment determined by the points of tangency of the two circles with $l_1$) and consider points $B$ and $C$ on $l_2$ such that $AB$ is tangent to $\Gamma_1$ and $AC$ is tangent to $\Gamma_2$. Let $D$ be the point of tangency of the ex-circle of $\triangle ABC$ with the side $BC$. If $X$ is the midpoint of $O_1O_2$, calculate the value of $\frac{AX}{XD}$ given that the radii of $\Gamma_1$ and $\Gamma_2$ are $r_1$ and $r_2$ respectively and $r_1 = 2r_2$.

In triangle \(ABC\), construct two externally squares \(CB'B"A\) and \(AC'C"B\) on sides \(BC\) and \(CA\) respectively. Let \(J\) and \(K\) be the centers of squares \(CB'B"A\) and \(AC'C"B\), respectively. Let \(Y\) and \(Z\) be the midpoints of \(CA\) and \(AB\), respectively, and let \(P\) be the midpoint of \(B"C'\). If \(AP\), \(JZ\), and \(KY\) intersect at a common point \(Q\), calculate the ratio \(\frac{AQ}{QP}\).
A group of boys decided to play a game of poker. They kept some cards away and played with 50 cards. How many cards did they keep away?

A contractor undertakes to build a wall in some days. He employs 40 people for the same. However, after 25 days, he finds that only 40% of the work is complete. He needs to employ 60 more people to complete the work in time. How many days was the contractor initially planning to complete the wall?

Ms. Hamilton's eighth-grade class wants to participate in the annual five-person-team hockey tournament. The losing team of each game is eliminated from the tournament. If thirty-two teams compete, how many games will be played to determine the winner?
A cube is 1 meter (m) long on one side, and a cuboid is 50 centimeters (cm) wide, 50 centimeters (cm) long, and 20 centimeters (cm) high. How many times the volume of this cube is the cuboid?

Three walls have wallpaper covering a combined area of 300 square meters. By overlapping the wallpaper to cover a wall with an area of some square meters, the area that is covered by exactly two layers of wallpaper is 38 square meters. The area that is covered with three layers of wallpaper is 41 square meters. What is the area of the wall that is covered by overlapping the wallpapers?

Let \(ABC\) be an acute-angled triangle with orthocenter \(H\) and midpoint \(M\) of side \(BC\). The point \(N\) is the foot of the perpendicular from \(H\) to \(AM\). If the circumradius of triangle \(ABC\) is \(R\) and the length of \(BC\) is \(a\), find the value of \(\frac{HN}{R}\) given that \(a = 2R\).

In convex quadrilateral \(ABCD\), \(CB\) and \(DA\) are external angle bisectors of \(\angle DCA\) and \(\angle CDB\), respectively. Points \(E\) and \(F\) lie on the rays \(AC\) and \(BD\), respectively, such that \(CEFD\) is a cyclic quadrilateral. Point \(P\) lies in the plane of quadrilateral \(ABCD\) such that \(DA\) and \(CB\) are external angle bisectors of \(\angle PDE\) and \(\angle PCF\), respectively. \(AD\) intersects \(BC\) at \(Q\). If \(P\) lies on \(AB\), find the ratio \(\frac{EF}{PQ}\) when \(Q\) lies on segment \(EF\).
Determine how you would express the number $360$ in base prime representation.

In a rectangular parallelepiped \(ABCDA_1B_1C_1D_1\), the lengths of the edges are given as \(AB=60\), \(AD=30\), and \(AA_1=15\). Point \(E\) is marked at the midpoint of edge \(A_1B_1\), and point \(F\) is marked at the midpoint of edge \(B_1C_1\). Find the distance between the lines \(AE\) and \(BF\).
Jack and Sam have a combined weight of 96 pounds. Jack is 8 pounds heavier than Sam. How much does Jack weigh?

Given a triangle \(ABC\) with \(AB < BC < AC\) inscribed in circle \((c)\). The circle \(c(A, AB)\) (with center \(A\) and radius \(AB\)) intersects the line \(BC\) at point \(D\) and the circle \((c)\) at point \(H\). The circle \(c(A, AC)\) (with center \(A\) and radius \(AC\)) intersects the line \(BC\) at point \(Z\) and the circle \((c)\) at point \(E\). Lines \(ZH\) and \(ED\) intersect at point \(T\). Calculate the ratio of the radii of the circumscribed circles of triangles \(TDZ\) and \(TEH\).

Jane brings 75% as many pieces of bread as treats to feed the live pets at the zoo. Wanda brings half as many treats as Jane and three times as many pieces of bread as treats. If Wanda brings 90 pieces of bread, and they are joined by two more friends, Carla and Peter. Carla brings 2.5 times as many treats as pieces of bread, and Peter brings twice as many pieces of bread as treats. If Carla brings 40 pieces of bread, and Peter brings a total of 140 bread and treats combined, what is the total number of pieces of bread and treats that Jane, Wanda, Carla, and Peter brought to the zoo?

The function $f(x)$ satisfies
\[f(x + f(x)) = 3f(x)\]for all $x,$ and $f(1) = 3.$  Find $f(13).$

Given a positive integer \( n > 1000 \), let \( S(n) \) be the sum of the residues of \( 2^n \) modulo each of the numbers \( 1, 2, 3, \ldots, n \). Calculate the smallest integer \( k \) such that \( S(n) > k \cdot \frac{n^2}{6} \). Find \( k \).
What is the smallest four-digit palindrome that is divisible by 3?
How many different ways can you place 6 (not necessarily distinct) tetris pieces (i.e., tetrominoes) on a 2×12 rectangle without overlap? Count rotations and reflections as distinct.

The Great Eighteen Soccer League has three divisions, with six teams in each division. Each team plays each of the other teams in its own division three times and every team in the other divisions twice. How many league games are scheduled?

The length of a rectangular landscape is 4 times its breadth. There is a playground in it whose area is 1200 square meters and which is 1/3 of the total landscape. What is the length of the landscape?

A man is 12 years older than his brother. In a certain number of years, his age will be twice the age of his brother. The present age of his brother is 10 years. How many years from now will the man's age be twice his brother's age?
A number's highest place is the million place, then this number is a \_\_\_\_\_\_ digit number.
Using 6 squares with a side length of 1 can form a shape with a side length of 1. To form a regular hexagon with a side length of 5, how many equilateral triangles with a side length of 1 are needed?

Let \( S \) be a set and let \( \aleph(S) \) denote the least ordinal which does not inject into \( S \) (the Hartogs number of \( S \)). Define \( f(S) \) as the smallest ordinal \( \alpha \) such that \( \aleph(S) < \mathcal{P}^\alpha(S) \), where \( \mathcal{P}^\alpha(S) \) denotes the \( \alpha \)-fold power set of \( S \). Find the value of \( f(S) \) for any non-empty set \( S \).

Let $f(x) = |3\{x\} - 1.5|$ where $\{x\}$ denotes the fractional part of $x$. Determine the smallest positive integer $m$ such that the equation \[m^2 f(xf(x)) = x\] has at least $1008$ real solutions.

It is given that \( \triangle CAB \cong \triangle EFD \). If \( AC = x + y + z \), \( AB = z + 6 \), \( BC = x + 8z \), \( EF = 3 \), \( DF = 2y - z \), and \( DE = y + 2 \), find \( x^2 + y^2 + z^2 \).

Let \( n \) be a composite natural number such that \( 101 \mid n \). For every non-trivial divisor \( d \) (where \( 1 < d < n \)) of \( n \), \( d \) is the difference of two other divisors of \( n \). Find the smallest possible value of \( n \) that satisfies these conditions.

If the sequence $\{a_{n}\}$ satisfies $a_{n}-a_{n-1}=3\left(n\geqslant 2\right)$, $a_{3}=-10$, then the general term of the sequence $a_{n}=$______. Let $S_{n}$ be the sum of the first $n$ terms of the sequence $\{a_{n}\}$. Find the value of $n$ when $S_{n}$ is at its minimum.

A certain school holds a choir competition in each grade, where the final score of each participating team is evaluated based on the song content accounting for 30%, singing skills accounting for 40%, and spirit accounting for 30%. If a participating team scores 90 points for song content, 94 points for singing skills, and 98 points for spirit, then the final score of this team is ______ points.
If $n$ is a positive integer, determine $f(n)$ as the sum of the digits of $\frac{1}{25^n}$. Find the smallest positive integer $n$ such that $f(n) > 20$.

Let \( n \) be a natural number not equal to 2, 5, or 13. For the set \(\{2, 5, 13, n\}\), calculate the sum of all distinct values of \( ab - 1 \) that are not perfect squares, where \( a \) and \( b \) are distinct elements of the set.
What is the molecular weight of some moles of Aluminium hydroxide if the molecular weight of 4 moles is 312?

There are six more white birds next to a cage than grey birds in the cage. If the number of grey birds in the cage is 40, and after ten minutes, half of the birds in the cage are freed and fly away, calculate the total number of birds remaining.
If a person walks at 14 km/hr instead of 10 km/hr, he would have walked 20 km more. What is the actual distance traveled by him at the slower speed?

Find the value of the following expression:
\[
\frac{\sin 8 \alpha+\sin 9 \alpha+\sin 10 \alpha+\sin 11 \alpha}{\cos 8 \alpha+\cos 9 \alpha+\cos 10 \alpha+\cos 11 \alpha} \times \frac{\cos 8 \alpha-\cos 9 \alpha-\cos 10 \alpha+\cos 11 \alpha}{\sin 8 \alpha-\sin 9 \alpha-\sin 10 \alpha+\sin 11 \alpha}.
\]

Two dogsled teams raced across a 300-mile course in Wyoming. Team A finished the course in fewer hours than Team W. Team A's average speed was 5 mph greater than Team W's, and Team W's average mph was 20. How many fewer hours did Team A take to finish the course compared to Team W?
Nate is reading a 400-page book. He finished reading 20% of the book. How many pages does he need to read to finish the book?
Fangfang has a total of 30 coins, consisting of 1-jiao and 5-jiao coins, amounting to 8 yuan and 6 jiao. How many coins of each type does she have?
Find the least possible value of \( a + b \) where \( a \) and \( b \) are positive integers such that \( 11 \) divides \( a + 13b \) and \( 13 \) divides \( a + 11b \).
A cube-shaped paper box without a lid is unfolded into a plane figure. How many possible configurations are there?
Haley grew 9 trees in her backyard. After a typhoon, some trees died. Then she grew 5 more trees. Now, she has 10 trees left. How many trees died due to the typhoon?

Given the function $f(x)=\ln x-ax+1$ where $a\in \mathbb{R}$:
1. Discuss the monotonicity of the function $f(x)$.
2. If $a=-2$, determine whether there exists a real number $m (m\in \mathbb{N}^{*})$ such that $f(x)\leqslant m(x+1)$ always holds. If it exists, find the minimum value of the real number $m$; if it does not exist, provide a reason.
Someone wrote the integers from 1 to 1999 in a row. What digit is in the 1999th position?

An English club is attended by 20 gentlemen. Some of them are acquainted (acquaintances are mutual, meaning if A knows B, then B knows A). It is known that no three gentlemen in the club are mutually acquainted with each other.

One day, the gentlemen came to the club, and each pair of acquaintances shook hands (once). What is the maximum number of handshakes that could have occurred?

Given \(a, b, c > 0\) satisfying \(a + b + c = 3\), calculate the minimum value of the expression:
\[
\frac{(1+a)^2(1+b)^2}{1+c^2} + \frac{(1+b)^2(1+c)^2}{1+a^2} + \frac{(1+c)^2(1+a)^2}{1+b^2}
\]
How many lattice points are enclosed by the triangle with vertices \((0, 99), (5, 100)\), and \((2003, 500)\)? Do not include the boundary points.

Let \( q(x) \) be a polynomial such that \( q(x) = p(x) - (x-1) \), where \( p(x) \) is a monic polynomial of degree 7 satisfying \( p(1) = 0, p(2) = 1, p(3) = 2, p(4) = 3, p(5) = 4, p(6) = 5, \) and \( p(7) = 6 \). Find \( p(8) \).

A certain family has 3 sons: Richard is 6 years older than David, and David is 8 years older than Scott. In a certain number of years, Richard will be twice as old as Scott. David was 12 years old 2 years ago. In how many years will Richard be twice as old as Scott?

Determine the minimum number of edges in a graph on \( n \) vertices such that there are exactly 6 colorings using three given colors, with no monochromatic triangles. These colorings are generated by cycling the colors around and are considered equivalent.
Let $f(x) = a\sin(\pi x + \theta) + b\cos(\pi x + \theta) + 3$ (where $a$, $b$, $\theta$ are non-zero real numbers). If $f(2016) = -1$, then $f(2017) = \_\_\_\_\_\_$.
Given a pentagon $PQRST$ formed by chords on a circle with side lengths $PQ = 16$, $QR = 25$, $RS = 33$, $ST = 52$, and $TP = 56$, determine the sum of all its diagonals.
A cube is painted red on all faces. It is then cut into 27 equal smaller cubes. How many smaller cubes are painted on only 2 faces?
Find all positive integers $n$ such that $n \cdot 2^{n-1} + 1$ is a perfect square.
The square root of \( x \) is greater than 5 and less than 6. How many integer values of \( x \) satisfy this condition?

After spending Rs. 5000 on rent, some amount on milk, Rs. 4500 on groceries, Rs. 2500 on children's education, Rs. 2000 on petrol, and Rs. 5200 on miscellaneous expenses, Mr. Kishore saved 10% of his monthly salary. He saved Rs. 2300. How much did he spend on milk?
Find the largest three-digit integer starting with $8$ that is divisible by each of its non-zero digits and also divisible by the sum of these digits.
On a given day in Denver, CO, the temperature was given by $-t^2 + 14t + 40$ where $t$ is the time in hours past noon. What is the smallest $t$ value at which the temperature was exactly 94 degrees?

There are 11 males & some females in the orchestra and twice that number in the band. There are 12 males & 17 females in the choir. There are 98 musicians total in the orchestra, the band, and the choir. How many females are there in the orchestra?
How many distinct numbers can you get by multiplying two or more distinct members of the set $\{1, 3, 7, 9, 13\}$ together?

If \( a, b, c > 0 \), find the minimum value of
\[
\frac{a(b+c)^2}{3a+2b+2c} + \frac{b(c+a)^2}{2a+3b+2c} + \frac{c(a+b)^2}{2a+2b+3c}.
\]

Find the number of positive solutions to
\[\sin (\arccos( \cot (\arcsin x) ) ) = x.\]

Two figures are constructed from unit squares. The first configuration forms a T-shape comprising 5 unit squares with 3 squares making up the top bar and 2 squares extending downwards from the center. The second configuration is a cross-shape consisting of 5 unit squares with one central square and one square extending in each cardinal direction. What is the positive difference of the perimeters, in units?

In Sam's collection, there are some more black pens than blue pens and twice as many blue pens as pencils. There are also eight pencils and two fewer red pens than pencils. There are 48 pens in all in Sam's collection. How many more black pens are there than blue pens?

Henley bought 300 candies and shared them with her two brothers and a cousin. However, they realized that 37.5% of the candies were sour, and they had to separate those out. If they then shared the good candies equally, how many candies did each get?
Damien jogs a certain number of miles per day on weekdays only. He runs 75 miles over three weeks. How many miles does he jog per day?
Find the largest length \( m \) of a geometric integer sequence \(\{a_k\}\) such that \(100 \le a_1 < a_2 < \cdots < a_m < 1000\).

A banker has a set of similarly looking golden coins, one of which is counterfeit and lighter in weight. Using a balance without weights, an expert must determine the counterfeit coin with the condition that each coin participates in no more than two weighings. What is the largest number of coins the banker could have to ensure the expert can complete the task?
Philip has a farm with animals. He has 20 cows, 50% more ducks. Philip also has as many pigs as one-fifth of ducks and cows in total. How many animals does Philip have on his farm?
What is the smallest \( n > 5 \) such that the angle trisectors of a regular \( n \)-gon intersect other vertices of the \( n \)-gon?

Consider the set \( X \) with elements \( x, y, z, t \). Let \( A = \| x - z \| \| y - t \| \) and \( B = \| x - y \| \| z - t \| + \| y - z \| \| x - t \| \). Calculate the minimum possible value of \( \frac{B}{A} \) over all possible choices of \( x, y, z, t \) in \( X \).
Find the greatest common divisor of $7488$ and $12467$.

Determine the number of ten-digit positive integers with the following properties: $\bullet$  Each of the digits  $0, 1, 2, . . . , 8$  and  $9$  is contained exactly once. $\bullet$  Each digit, except  $9$ , has a neighbouring digit that is larger than it.
(Note. For example, in the number  $1230$ , the digits  $1$  and  $3$  are the neighbouring digits of  $2$   while  $2$  and  $0$  are the neighbouring digits of  $3$ . The digits  $1$  and  $0$  have only one neighbouring digit.)

*(Karl Czakler)*
Tom bought 10 packages of miniature racing cars. Each package contains five cars. He gave each of his two nephews 1/5 of the cars. How many miniature racing cars are left with Tom?

In a bus, there are 15 seats available on the left side, 3 fewer seats on the right side because of the rear exit door. Each seat can hold a certain number of people. In addition, there is a seat at the back that can sit 8 people all together. The bus can sit 89 people all together. How many people can each seat hold?

How many non-empty subsets \( S \) of \( \{1, 2, 3, \ldots, 12\} \) have the following two properties?
1. No two consecutive integers belong to \( S \).
2. If \( S \) contains \( k \) elements, then \( S \) contains no number less than \( k \).

Given a polynomial \( f(x) \) of degree \( n \) with integer coefficients such that \( f(0) = 39 \) and \( f(x_1) = f(x_2) = f(x_3) = \cdots = f(x_n) = 2017 \) for distinct \( x_1, x_2, x_3, \ldots, x_n \), find the largest possible value of \( n \).
Given that \(a, b, c\) are positive real numbers, prove that \( \sqrt{3} \sqrt[3]{(a+b)(b+c)(c+a)} \geq 2 \sqrt{ab+bc+ca} \).

Consider a set of $n$ arithmetic progressions with differences $r_1, r_2, \dots, r_n$ and first terms $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$ that together cover all natural numbers. Calculate the value of $\frac{a_1}{r_1} + \frac{a_2}{r_2} + \cdots + \frac{a_n}{r_n}$ for $n = 5$.
Let $P(x) = b_0 + b_1x + \dots + b_mx^m$ be a polynomial with integer coefficients, and $0\le b_i<4$ for all $0 \le i \le m$. Given that $P(\sqrt{5}) = 15 + 26\sqrt{5}$, compute $P(3)$.

Michael makes birdhouses to sell at craft shows. He charges $22 for each large birdhouse, $16 for each medium birdhouse, and $7 for each small birdhouse. This week, he sold a certain number of large birdhouses, 2 medium birdhouses, and 3 small birdhouses, making a total of $97. How many large birdhouses did he sell?

There are exactly 120 Twitter subscribers from National Science High School. Each of 10 given celebrities has at least 85 followers from National Science High School. Let \( S \) be the set of all pairs of students such that each of the 10 celebrities is followed by at least one of the students in the pair. Calculate the minimum possible size of \( S \).

Let $P$ be the maximum possible value of $x_1x_2+x_2x_3+\cdots +x_6x_1$ where $x_1, x_2, \dots, x_6$ is a permutation of $(1,2,3,4,5,6)$ and let $Q$ be the number of permutations for which this maximum is attained. Evaluate $P+Q$.
In quadrilateral \(ABCD\), it is given that \(AB = BC = 4 \text{ cm}\). Angles \(\angle ABC\) and \(\angle CDA\) are \(100^\circ\) and \(130^\circ\), respectively. Find the length of \(BD\).
Compute $\binom{1502}{1}$.

After a reading activity at a certain school, 4 different classic books are to be awarded to 3 students, with each student receiving at least one book. The number of different ways to award the books is $\_\_\_\_\_\_$.

Hillary and Eddy are climbing to the summit of Mt. Everest from a base camp 5,000 ft from the summit. When they depart for the summit at 06:00, Hillary climbs at a rate of 800 ft/hr with Eddy lagging behind at a slower rate. Hillary stops 1,000 ft short of the summit and then descends at a rate of 1,000 ft/hr. Hillary and Eddy pass each other on her return trip at 12:00. What is Eddy's climbing rate in ft/hr?

The grade point average of one third of the classroom is some value; the grade point average of the rest is 18. The grade point average of the whole class is 17. What is the grade point average of one third of the classroom?

Given the hyperbola $M$: $\frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}} - \frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}} = 1 (a > 0, b > 0)$ with its right focus $F(c, 0)$. The line $x=a$ intersects the parabola $y^{2} = \frac{4}{3}cx$ at points $A$ and $B$, forming a right triangle $\triangle ABF$. Determine the eccentricity of the hyperbola $M$.

Let \(a, b, c\) be positive real numbers. Calculate the minimum value of the expression
\[ \dfrac{b+c}{2a^2+bc}+\dfrac{c+a}{2b^2+ca}+\dfrac{a+b}{2c^2+ab}. \]

Let \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c\) be nonzero complex numbers such that \(a + b + c = 30\) and
\[(a - b)^2 + (a - c)^2 + (b - c)^2 = 2abc.\] Find \(\frac{a^3 + b^3 + c^3}{abc}\).
Consider the sequence defined by $v_0=3$ and $v_{n+1}=v_n^2-2$. Let $m$ be the smallest positive integer such that $v_m \equiv 0 \pmod{2^{89}-1}$. Find the value of $m$.

In triangle $XYZ$, medians $\overline{XU}$ and $\overline{YV}$ are perpendicular. If $XU = 10$ and $YV = 24$, and the altitude from vertex $Z$ to $\overline{XY}$ is $16$, calculate the area of triangle $XYZ$.

The letters of the alphabet are given numeric values based on the two conditions below.

$\bullet$  Only the numeric values of $-3,$ $-2,$ $-1,$ $0,$ $1,$ $2,$ and $3$ are used.

$\bullet$  Starting with A and going through Z, a numeric value is assigned to each letter according to the following pattern: \[
1, 2, 0, 1, 0, -1, -2, 0, -1, 0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 0, -1, -2, 0, -1, 0,\ldots
\]
This pattern has a cycle of length $10$. The letter A has a value of $1$, B of $2$, C is $0$, ..., J is $0$, and Z cycles back in a similar pattern starting again from the list.

Calculate the sum of the numeric values of the letters in the word ``harmonics."

Consider the set \(\{1, 2, 3, \ldots, 2010\}\). Determine the number of ways to partition this set into 402 subsets, each containing 5 members, such that the sum of the numbers in each subset is divisible by 2011. Provide your answer modulo \(10^9 + 7\).
Convert $173_{10}$ to base 2. Let $x$ be the number of zeros and $y$ be the number of ones in base 2. What is the value of $y-x$?
Solve for $x$: \[\frac{3x-15}{4} = \frac{x + 9}{5}\].

In a football championship, 16 teams participated. Each team played against every other team once. A win was awarded 3 points, a draw 1 point, and a loss 0 points. A team is called successful if it earned at least half of the maximum possible points. What is the maximum number of successful teams that could be in the tournament?

How many four-digit integers $abcd$, with $a \not\equiv 0$, have the property that the three two-digit integers $ab < bc < cd$ form an increasing arithmetic sequence? One such number is $4692$, where $a=4$, $b=6$, $c=9$, and $d=2$.
In the Cartesian coordinate system, the distance from point $A(-6,8)$ to the origin is ______.
How many three-digit numbers are left if we exclude all three-digit numbers in which there are exactly two identical digits, and these two identical digits are adjacent?

Suppose I have a bag with 12 slips of paper in it.  Some of the slips have a 2 on them, and the rest have a 7 on them.  If the expected value of the number shown on a slip randomly drawn from the bag is $3.25$, then how many slips have a 2?
A train that is 360 meters long is running at a speed of 36 km/hour. In what time will it pass a bridge of 140 meters in length?

Hartley has 4 puppies that each weigh 7.5 kilograms. The rescue center has some cats that each weigh 2.5 kilograms. The cats weigh 5 kilograms more than the puppies. How many cats are at the rescue center?

Find the minimum value of
\[
\frac{x^2 + 1}{y - 2} + \frac{y^2 + 1}{x - 2}
\]
for real numbers \( x > 2 \) and \( y > 2 \).
Among the natural numbers from 1 to 1000 (inclusive), how many are divisible by 2 or 3 or 5, but not by 6?

Given that \( ab = cd \), find the smallest integer value of \( n \) such that \( a^n + b^n + c^n + d^n \) is guaranteed to be composite for any integers \( a, b, c, \) and \( d \) satisfying the condition.

A natural number \( n \) is called good if and only if it can be represented as \( n = x^3 + y^3 + z^3 \) where \( x, y, z \in \mathbb{Z}_{+} \). For all \( i = 0, 1, 2, 3 \), there exist infinitely many natural numbers \( n \) such that exactly \( i \) of the numbers \( n, n+2, n+28 \) are good.

Fill the numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 into the given table (the letters and numbers in the table are used to denote rows and columns, like D3 represents the white cell in row D, column 3) such that each row and each column contains five different numbers. Here are some hints:

1. The sum of the numbers in the cells of the 4th column is 9.
2. The sum of the numbers in the white cells of row C is 7.
3. The sum of the numbers in the white cells of the 2nd column is 8.
4. The sum of the numbers in the white cells of row B is less than the sum of the numbers in the white cells of row D.

What is the number in cell D4?

Let \(a, b, c \in \mathbb{R}^{+}\) with \(a + b + c = 1\). Find the minimum value of the expression 
\[ 1 + 13abc + 5(b^2c^2 + c^2a^2 + a^2b^2) - 5(bc + ca + ab). \]

Determine the number of ordered pairs of integers $(a,b)$ where $1 \leq a \leq 50$ and $b > 0$ such that the polynomial $x^2 + ax + b$ can be factored into the product of two linear factors with integer coefficients.
In a class, 7 students like to play basketball and 5 like to play cricket. 3 students like to play both basketball and cricket. How many students like to play basketball or cricket or both?
Find the last three digits of \(7^{83}\).

For some positive integers $a$ and $b$, the product \[\log_a(a+1) \cdot \log_{a+1} (a+2) \dotsm \log_{b-2} (b-1)  \cdot\log_{b-1} b\] contains exactly $891$ terms, and its value is $3.$ Compute $a+b.$
Define a sequence $(a_n)_{n\geq 1}$ by $a_1=1$ and $a_{n+1}=\dfrac{n}{a_n}+\dfrac{a_n}{n}$. Calculate the value of $\lfloor a_{10}^2 \rfloor$.

Walking uphill with a 15% incline and stopping at a coffee shop for 6 minutes, I cover the distance to the bus stop at 4/5 of my usual speed and arrive at the bus stop 9 minutes later than my normal time without incline and coffee shop. How many minutes does it take to walk to the bus stop at my usual speed on a flat path without stopping at the coffee shop?

Consider triangle \(ABC\) with \(\angle A = 120^\circ\). Let \(W\) be the midpoint of the largest arc \(BC\) of the circumcircle \((ABC)\). Let the internal bisector of \(\angle BAC\) intersect \(BC\) at \(A'\). Let \(F\) be the second Fermat point of \(ABC\). Let \(P\) be the intersection of lines \(AF\) and \(WA'\). If \(P\) lies on the circumcircle \((ABC)\), find the measure of \(\angle BPC\) in degrees.

Find all positive integers $n$ such that there exists a function $f\colon \mathbb{R}^{+} \to \mathbb{R}^{+}$ satisfying the condition $f(x+y)\geq yf_{n}(x)$ for all $x,y>0$, where $f_{n}(x)=f(f(\ldots f(x)\ldots ))$ (the $n$-th iterate of $f$).
A positive-starting arithmetic sequence $\left\{a_{n}\right\}$ satisfies $\frac{a_{3}}{a_{4}}=\frac{7}{5}$. Find the value of $n$ when the sum of its first $n$ terms, $S_{n}$, reaches the maximum.

Two distinct, real, infinite geometric series each have a sum of $1$ and have the same second term. The third term of one of the series is $1/8$, and the second term of both series can be written in the form $\frac{\sqrt{m}-n}p$, where $m$, $n$, and $p$ are positive integers and $m$ is not divisible by the square of any prime. Find $100m+10n+p$.

Say that a 4-digit positive integer is *mixed* if it has 4 distinct digits, its leftmost digit is neither the biggest nor the smallest of the 4 digits, and its rightmost digit is not the smallest of the 4 digits.  For example, 2013 is mixed.  How many 4-digit positive integers are mixed?
A group of men decided to do a work in 10 days, but 5 of them became absent. The rest of the group did the work in 12 days. How many men were in the original group?

Let \( s(x) = -x \). Consider a subset \( A \subset \mathbb{C} \) which satisfies \( s(A) = A \) and if \( A \subset F_1 \cup F_2 \) where:
i) \( F_1 \) and \( F_2 \) are two closed subsets of \( \mathbb{C} \),
ii) \( F_1 \cap F_2 \cap A = \emptyset \),
iii) \( s(F_1) = F_1 \) and \( s(F_2) = F_2 \),

then \( A \subset F_1 \) or \( A \subset F_2 \). In other words, one has \( s(A) = A \) and \( \{z^2 \mid z \in A\} \) is connected. Find the number of distinct connected subsets \( B \subset \mathbb{C} \) such that \( A = B \cup s(B) \) if \( A \) is the union of two disjoint closed disks centered at \( 1 \) and \( -1 \) with radius \( 1 \).
If $\sqrt{1-x}+|{2-y}|=0$, then the value of $x+y$ is ____.

In an acute triangle \( \triangle ABC \) with \( AB > AC \), construct the tangent to the circumcircle of \( \triangle ABC \) passing through \( A \) which meets \( BC \) at \( D \). Let the altitude from \( A \) to \( OD \) be \( E \). If \( AB = 13 \), \( AC = 12 \), and \( BC = 15 \), calculate the length of \( EB \).
Compute the expression $1004^2 - 996^2 - 1002^2 + 998^2$ without using a calculator.
In triangle \(ABC\), let \(H\) be the orthocenter and \(D\) be the foot of the altitude from \(A\) to \(BC\). If \(E\) is the midpoint of \(AH\), find the value of \(\angle ADE\) in degrees.

Let \( a, b, c, d \) be real numbers. Calculate the minimum value of the expression
\[ a(a + b)^3 + b(b + c)^3 + c(c + d)^3 + d(d + a)^3. \]

a copy machine , working at a constant rate , makes 35 copies per minute . a second copy machine , working at a constant rate , makes 65 copies per minute . working together at their respective rates , how many copies do the two machines make in half an hour ?
If $x\cdot x^{a}\cdot x^{b}\cdot x^{c}=x^{2024}$ ($x\neq 1$), then $a+b+c=\_\_\_\_\_\_$.
What is the smallest three-digit integer that can be expressed as the sum of a positive integer power of $2$ and a positive integer power of $3$ in two different ways?
A number, when divided by the sum of a certain number and 445, gives 2 times their difference as quotient and 50 as remainder. The number is 220050. What is the first number?

Consider a square lattice with \( N \) small boxes where \( N \) is an odd number, and Number-fullly starts at the center box. Each of the remaining boxes contains a unique positive integer. Number-fullly can only move to neighboring boxes and must eat the number in each box it visits. Each number \( n \) has a weight of \( \frac{1}{n} \) kg. Number-fullly can eat no more than 2 kg of numbers. Determine the minimum value of \( k \) such that if every box contains an integer from 1 to \( k \), Number-fullly cannot find a way to leave the square lattice while eating no more than 2 kg of numbers for \( N = 2003 \).
The product of positive integers $a$, $b$, and $c$ equals 1716. What is the minimum possible value of the sum $a + b + c$?

Suresh can complete a job in 15 hours. Ashutosh alone can complete the same job in some hours. Suresh works for 9 hours and then the remaining job is completed by Ashutosh in 10 hours. How many hours does it take for Ashutosh to complete the job alone?

In triangle \( ABC \), let \( D \) and \( E \) be the feet of the altitudes from \( A \) and \( B \), \( F \) be the intersection point of the angle bisector from \( C \) with side \( AB \), and \( O \), \( I \), and \( H \) be the circumcenter, incenter, and orthocenter of triangle \( ABC \), respectively. Given that \(\frac{CF}{AD} + \frac{CF}{BE} = 2\), calculate the value of \(\frac{OI}{IH}\).

Find the area of the region described by $x \ge 0,$ $y \ge 0,$ and
\[50 \{x\} \ge \lfloor x \rfloor + \lfloor y \rfloor.\]
where $\{x\} = x - \lfloor x \rfloor$ is the fractional part of $x$.

Bruce buys 5 packs of crayons at $5 each, 10 books at $5 each, and 3 calculators at $5 each. He also has a 20% discount coupon for the books. If he has $200, how many bags can he buy with the change if one bag costs $10 each?
Calculate the total sum of all positive integers \( x \) for which there are exactly \( 2 \) positive two-digit multiples followed by one three-digit multiple.

4 kilograms =     grams        3 meters - 2 decimeters =     decimeters  
8 meters =     decimeters        1600 grams - 600 grams =     kilograms．
Evaluate the integral \( \int_{0}^{2\pi} e^{\cos x} \cos(\sec x) \, dx \).
Define a sequence  $\{a_{n}\}_{n=1}^{\infty}$  via  $a_{1} = 1$  and  $a_{n+1} = a_{n} + \lfloor \sqrt{a_{n}} \rfloor$  for all  $n \geq 1$ . What is the smallest  $N$  such that  $a_{N} > 2017$ ?

Consider the sequence of natural numbers $x_n$ for which $2x_n^2 + 1$ can be expressed as the sum of two nonzero perfect squares. Let $S_n$ be the sum of the squares of the two nonzero integers whose squares sum to $2x_n^2 + 1$. Find the value of $S_5$.
Calculate $2\log_{5}25 + 3\log_{2}64 - 81\ln1$.
Let $a$, $b$, $c$ be the roots of the cubic equation $3x^3 - 9x^2 + x - 15 = 0.$ Find the product $abc$.
The number 236! ends in how many zeros when expressed as an integer?
In how many ways can the numbers from 1 to 100 be arranged in a $2 \times 50$ rectangle such that every pair of consecutive numbers (numbers differing by 1) are always in cells with a common side?
How many even numbers are greater than 500 and less than 800?
What is the remainder when $3^{40} + 5$ is divided by $5$?
A bathroom has 10 6 inch tiles along its width and 20 6 inch tiles along its length.  What is the square footage of the bathroom?
Let \( x \in (0, 1) \) and \( n \in \mathbb{N}^* \). Find the maximum value of the expression \( x \sqrt[n]{1-x} \) and express it in the form \( \frac{1}{\sqrt{2ne}} \cdot k \). What is \( k \)?

Find the least number which when divided by 20, 2535, and 40 leaves remainders 14, 1929, and some remainder respectively. The least number is 1394. What is the remainder when the least number is divided by 40?

Let \(ABCD\) be a quadrilateral with \(\angle CAB = \angle CBA = \angle ACD < 45^\circ\) and \(\angle ACB = 2 \angle ADC\). Let \(I\) be the intersection of \(AC\) and \(BD\), and \(E\) be the projection of \(A\) on \(BC\). If the area of \(\triangle IAB\) is \(x\) and the area of quadrilateral \(DICE\) is \(y\), find the value of \(x - y\).
In a taxi, one passenger can sit in the front and three in the back. In how many ways can the four passengers be seated if one of them wants to sit by the window?
Determine the median of the following numbers: 1, 1, 3, 3, 5.
Let $p$ be a prime number. Find the smallest prime number $q$ such that for every integer $n$, the number $n^p - p$ is not divisible by $q$, and calculate $q^2 - p$.

In triangle \( ABC \), let \( I_a \) be the excenter opposite \( A \), and let \( AI_a \) intersect the circumcircle of \( ABC \) at \( T \). Let \( X \) be a point on \( TI_a \) such that \( XI_a^2 = XA \cdot XT \). Draw a perpendicular from \( X \) to \( BC \) intersecting \( BC \) at \( A' \). Define \( B' \) and \( C' \) similarly. Let \( P \) be the point of concurrency of \( AA' \), \( BB' \), and \( CC' \). If \( AP = 12 \), find the length of \( A'I_a \).

Let \( S \) be the set of rational numbers \( r \) where \( 0 < r < 1 \), and \( r \) can be expressed as a repeating decimal \( \overline{0.abcabcabc\cdots} = \overline{0.a\dot{b}\dot{c}} \), where \( a, b, \) and \( c \) are not necessarily distinct. How many distinct numerators can elements of \( S \) have when expressed in simplest fractional form?

(10th Annual American Mathematics Invitational, 1992)

Let \((a_n)\) be a sequence of positive integers such that \(a_0 = 2\), \(a_1 = 3\), and for all \(n \geq 2\), \(n(a_{n-1} - 1) + a_n = \frac{a_{n+1}}{n+1} + 1\). Find all prime numbers \(p, q, r\) such that \(a_p \cdot a_q \cdot a_r\) is a power of a prime number.

There are 100 black balls and 100 white balls in a box. What is the minimum number of balls that need to be drawn, without looking, to ensure that there are at least 2 balls of the same color? To ensure that there are at least 2 white balls?
Let $C$ equal the number of four-digit numbers that are both odd and divisible by 5. Let $D$ equal the number of four-digit numbers that are divisible by 25. Find $C+D$.

In triangle \(ABC\), let \(O\) be the circumcenter, \(H\) be the orthocenter, \(iH\) be the isotomic conjugate of \(H\) with respect to \(ABC\), and \(iO\) be the isotomic conjugate of \(O\) with respect to \(ABC\). If the coordinates of \(H\) are \((h_1, h_2)\), \(iH\) are \((i_1, i_2)\), and \(iO\) are \((o_1, o_2)\), calculate the value of \(\frac{i_2 - h_2}{i_1 - h_1} - \frac{o_2 - h_2}{o_1 - h_1}\).

Let  $p = 2017$  be a prime number. Let  $E$  be the expected value of the expression \[3 \;\square\; 3 \;\square\; 3 \;\square\; \cdots \;\square\; 3 \;\square\; 3\] where there are  $p+3$  threes and  $p+2$  boxes, and one of the four arithmetic operations  $\{+, -, \times, \div\}$  is uniformly chosen at random to replace each of the boxes. If  $E = \tfrac{m}{n}$ , where  $m$  and  $n$  are relatively prime positive integers, find the remainder when  $m+n$  is divided by  $p$ .

*Proposed by Michael Tang*
Let  $P(x)$  be the polynomial of degree at most  $6$  which satisfies  $P(k)=k!$  for  $k=0,1,2,3,4,5,6$ . Compute the value of  $P(7)$ .

(1) Given the function $f(x)=\cos x+\sqrt{3}\sin x$, find the value of $f'(\frac{\pi}{3})$.

(2) In the polar coordinate system, the chord length intercepted by the line $\rho\sin \theta+\rho\cos \theta=2\sqrt{2}$ on the circle $\rho=2\sqrt{2}$ is \_\_\_\_\_\_.

(3) Given the function $f(x)=x^{3}+ax^{2}+bx-a^{2}-7a$ that attains a maximum value of $10$ at $x=1$, find the value of $a+b$.

(4) Given the function $f(x)=x^{3}-ax^{2}+3ax+1$ that has both a maximum and a minimum value in the interval $(-2,2)$, find the range of the real number $a$.
a 300 m long train crosses a platform in 27 sec while it crosses a signal pole in 18 sec . what is the length of the platform ?

For natural numbers $m$ greater than 1, the cube of $m$ can be "split" into odd numbers in the following way: $$2^{3} \begin{cases} 3 \\ 5\end{cases}$$, $$3^{3} \begin{cases} 7 \\ 9 \\ 11\end{cases}$$, $$4^{3} \begin{cases} 13 \\ 15 \\ 17 \\ 19\end{cases}$$... In this manner, if one of the "split numbers" of $m^3$ is 59, then the value of $m$ is \_\_\_\_\_\_.
the ratio between the length and the breadth of a rectangular plot is 7 : 5 . if the perimeter of the plot is 288 metres , what is its area ?

Given \( x, y, z > 0 \), let \( f(x, y, z) = \frac{x}{y + z} + \frac{y}{z + x} + \frac{z}{x + y} - \frac{4x^2 + (x + y)^2}{(2x + y + z)^2} - \frac{4y^2 + (y + z)^2}{(2y + x + z)^2} - \frac{4z^2 + (z + x)^2}{(2z + x + y)^2} \). Calculate the minimum value of \( f(x, y, z) \).
the grade point average of one third of the classroom is 45 ; the grade point average of the rest is 60 . what is the grade point average of the whole class ?

the perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 60 . if one of the sides of the equilateral triangle is the side of an isosceles triangle of perimeter 70 , then how long is the base of isosceles triangle ?
Evaluate $\log_{3}{81}-\log_{3}{\frac{1}{9}}$.

The graph of $y = \frac{r(x)}{s(x)}$, where $r(x)$ and $s(x)$ are quadratic polynomials, has a horizontal asymptote at $y = -3$ and a vertical asymptote at $x = 3$. There is also a hole in the graph at $x = -4$. Determine $\frac{r(0)}{s(0)}$ given that the graph passes through the point $(2, 0)$.

A circle with center at \( O \) is inscribed in quadrilateral \( ABCD \) with points of tangency at \( E \) (on \( AB \)), \( F \) (on \( BC \)), \( G \) (on \( CD \)), and \( H \) (on \( AD \)). \( AB \) is parallel to \( DC \), but \( AD \) is not parallel to \( BC \). Given \( AD = 337 \), \( BE = 62 \), \( FC = 225 \), and \( DG = AE + 175 \), find the value of \( k + w \) where \( \frac{DO}{AO} = \frac{k}{w} \) and \( k \) and \( w \) are relatively prime positive integers.

In a plane, there are two families of lines given by \( y = x + r \) and \( y = -x + r \), where \( r \in \{0, 1, 2, 3, 4\} \). Find the number of squares with diagonals of length 2 formed by these lines.

Consider $n \geq 3$ points in general position in the plane such that the sum of the distances from each point to all other points is the same for every point. Let $P$ be one of these points and let $S$ be the sum of the distances from $P$ to all other points. If $n=6$, find the value of $S$ given that the distance between any two points is an integer and the smallest such distance is $1$.
Amoli and Anayet must travel 369 miles together. Amoli drove 42 miles an hour for 3 hours and Anayet drove at 61 miles an hour for 2 hours. How many miles do they still need to travel?
How many perfect squares less than 5000 have a ones digit of 4, 5, or 6?

Given a circle $(O)$ with tangents $ST$ and $ST'$, and a secant $SAB$. A line through $A$ perpendicular to $OT$ intersects $TT'$ and $TB$ at points $C$ and $D$, respectively. If $AC = 5$, find the length of $CD$.
The average age of 10 men increases by 2 years when two women are included in place of two men of ages 10 and 12 years. What is the average age of the women?

Andy, Bella, and Casey each shared riddles with their friends Dan, Emma, and Fiona. Andy shared 12 riddles more than Dan received. Bella got 7 riddles less than what Andy shared, and she passed half of those riddles to Emma. Casey shared as many riddles with Fiona as the total number Andy shared and Bella got from Andy. If Dan received 21 riddles, how many riddles did Fiona get?
Given the sets $A=\{2,4\}$ and $B=\{a,a^{2}+3\}$, if $A \cap B = \{2\}$, then the value of the real number $a$ is __________.

For a triangle \(ABC\) with sides \(a\), \(b\), and \(c\), let \(h_b\) and \(h_c\) be the heights relative to sides \(b\) and \(c\), respectively. If \(p\) is the semi-perimeter of the triangle, find the minimum value of \(\frac{p}{(h_b + h_c) \cos\left(\frac{A}{2}\right)}\).
The schools debate team had 28 boys and some girls on it. If they were split into groups of 4, they could make 8 groups. How many girls were on the debate team?
Three positive integers $p$, $q$, and $r$ satisfy $p \cdot q \cdot r = 8!$ and $p<q<r$. Find the smallest possible value of $r-q$.
What three-digit positive integer is one more than a multiple of 2, 3, 5, and 7?
What is the smallest positive integer $n$ such that $5n$ is a perfect square and $4n$ is a perfect cube?
Given the function $f(x+1) = 2^{x-1}$, find the value of $f(5)$.
Mike picked some limes, and Alyssa ate 25.0 limes. Tom picked 12.0 plums. There were 7 limes left. How many limes did Mike pick?

Let  $\phi = \tfrac{1+\sqrt 5}2$  be the positive root of  $x^2=x+1$ .  Define a function  $f:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$  by
\begin{align*}
f(0) &= 1
f(2x) &= \lfloor\phi f(x)\rfloor
f(2x+1) &= f(2x) + f(x).
\end{align*}
Find the remainder when  $f(2007)$  is divided by  $2008$ .

Let \( x, y, z > 0 \) such that \( xy + yz + zx + 3xyz = 4 \). Calculate the minimum value of the expression 
\[ 3\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{y}} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{z}}\right)^2 - (x+2)(y+2)(z+2). \]

A $4 \times 4$ grid has its 16 cells colored arbitrarily in three colors. A swap is an exchange between the colors of two cells. Determine the maximum number of swaps required to produce a line of symmetry, regardless of the grid's initial coloring. If it is not always possible to achieve a line of symmetry within a certain number of swaps, provide the smallest number of swaps for which it is always possible or state that no such number exists. Calculate this number.

Given a sequence of positive terms \(\left\{a_{n}\right\}\) with the sum of the first \(n\) terms \(S_{n}\) satisfying \(S_{n}^{2} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{i}^{3}\),
(1) Find the general term of the sequence \(\left\{a_{n}\right\}\);
(2) Prove:
$$
\sum_{k=1}^{n} \frac{\sqrt{k}}{a_{k}^{2}} < 3
$$

A person walks at a certain speed instead of 10 km/hr, and as a result, he would have walked 20 km more. The actual distance travelled by him is 50 km. What is the faster speed he could have walked at?

In the diagram below, points $A$, $B$, $C$, and $Q$ are situated so that $QA=5$, $QB=12$, $QC=13$, and $BC=10$. What is the maximum possible area of $\triangle ABC$? Assume the figure placement similar to the provided scenario but apply necessary adjustments due to changes in values.

In triangle $ABC$, let the sides opposite angles $A$, $B$, and $C$ be $a$, $b$, and $c$ respectively. It is known that $a^{2}+c^{2}-b^{2}=ac$ and $\sqrt{2}b= \sqrt{3}c$.
$(1)$ Find the measure of angle $A$.
$(2)$ Let $f(x)=1+\cos(2x+B)-\cos(2x)$. Find the maximum value of the function $f(x)$.
Compute $63 \times 57$ using mental math strategies.

Two out of every seven people in a city suffer from allergies. In a random sample of 350 people from this city:
a. How many would you expect to suffer from allergies?
b. Suppose that three out of every ten people in the same sample are left-handed. How many people would you expect to be both left-handed and suffer from allergies, assuming that being left-handed and suffering from allergies are independent?

Mabel is counting sharks, tuna, and eels in the ocean. She knows that of the fish that she sees, 20% will be sharks, 30% will be tuna, and 50% will be eels. On day one she counts 20 fish. On day 2, she counts three times as many fish as on day one. On day 3, she counts 25% less fish than on day 2. How many sharks did she count over those three days?

University Theater sold 510 tickets for a play. Tickets cost 21 dollars per adult and a certain amount per senior citizen. The total receipts were 8748 dollars. They sold 327 senior citizen tickets. How much does a senior citizen ticket cost?
Adam teaches 50 students a year. In the first year, he only teaches 40 students. How many students will Adam teach in 10 years?

A certain product's per-unit selling price $P$ (in yuan) over the past $30$ days is related to time $t$ (in days) with the function $p= \begin{cases} t+20,0 < t < 25,t\in\mathbb{N}^* \\ -t+70,25\leqslant t\leqslant 30,t\in\mathbb{N}^* \end{cases}$. The product's daily sales volume $Q$ (in units) is related to time $t$ (in days) with the function $Q=-t+40(0 < t\leqslant 30,t\in\mathbb{N}^*)$. Determine the maximum daily sales revenue for this product, and identify which of the $30$ days had the maximum daily sales revenue.

Find the last two digits of the number of ordered triples of natural numbers $(a, b, c)$ satisfying the equation:
$$\sum_{\text{cyc}} \frac{(a+1)(a^2+1)}{(a-b)(a-c)} = 2022$$
Let $\alpha, \beta,$ and $\gamma$ be the three roots of $x^3 - x - 1$. What is the value of $\frac{1-\alpha}{1+\alpha}+\frac{1-\beta}{1+\beta}+\frac{1-\gamma}{1+\gamma}$?

Evaluate the expression
\[
  \frac{196 \left( \frac{1}{19} - \frac{1}{23} \right) 
          + 361 \left( \frac{1}{23} - \frac{1}{17} \right) + 289 \left( \frac{1}{17} - \frac{1}{19} \right)}{
        14 \left( \frac{1}{19} - \frac{1}{23} \right)

\]
Compute $\dbinom{60}{3}$.

Let $BH$ be an altitude of acute scalene triangle $ABC$. Points $K$ and $L$ are chosen on sides $AB$ and $BC$ respectively such that $BK = BH = BL$. The circumcircles of $\triangle AKH$ and $\triangle CLH$ intersect for the second time at point $P$ and intersect ray $BH$ for the second time at points $Q$ and $R$ respectively. If $O$ is the circumcenter of $\triangle PQR$ and $I$ is the incenter of $\triangle ABC$, calculate the value of $\frac{OI}{IH}$, where $H$ is the foot of the altitude from $B$ to $AC$.
Determine the integer nearest to $500 \sum_{n=2}^{5000} \frac{1}{n^2 - 1}$.

Given the following system of equations:
\begin{align*}
xy &= 8 - 2x - 3y,\\
yz &= 8 - 4y - 2z,\\
xz &= 40 - 5x - 3z,
\end{align*}
find the positive solution for $x$.

Mike has 35 books in his library. He bought several books at a yard sale over the weekend and also gave away a few books to his friends. After these transactions, he now has 56 books in his library. If Mike gave away 12 books to his friends, how many books did he buy at the yard sale?

Let \( I_1 = \int_{0}^{1}\sqrt{\frac{\arctan x}{-x^{2}+2x+1}}\,dx \) and \( I_2 = \int_{0}^{1}\frac{\log(1+x)}{-x^{2}+2x+1}\,dx \). Calculate the value of \( \frac{I_1^2}{I_2} \) and round your answer to the nearest integer.

Apple costs l rupees per kilogram for the first 30 kgs and q rupees per kilogram for each additional kilogram. The price of 33 kilograms is 333 and for 36 kgs of apples is a certain amount. The cost of the first 15 kgs of apples is 150. What is the price of 36 kilograms of apples?
For what value of $x$ is $5^3 - 7 = 6^2 + x$?
Calculate the total number of distinct, natural-number factors for the number $8^2 \cdot 9^3 \cdot 5^5 \cdot 7^1$.

Let \(z\) be a complex number such that \(|z - 3 + 2i| = 3.\) Find the minimum value of
\[
|z + 1 - i|^2 + |z - 7 + 3i|^2.
\]
If Layla scored 104 goals in four hockey games and Kristin scored 24 fewer goals in the same four games, calculate the average number of goals the two scored.
Consider a triangle with side lengths of $x$, 7, and 9. What is the positive difference between the greatest and least possible integral values of $x$?

Let \( A \) be a set of \( n \) positive integers. Define the set \( B = \left\{ \frac{ab}{\gcd(a,b)^2} \mid a, b \in A \right\} \). Calculate the minimum possible number of distinct elements in \( B \) for \( n = 7 \).

jack spent 1 / 6 of his lifetime in adolescence . his facial hair started growing after 1 / 12 more of his life . he successfully married his girlfriend diana after 1 / 7 more of his life . their son was born after 5 years from then . the son lived just 1 / 2 of what jack lived . jack dies 4 years after his son died . how long did jack live ?
Determine the number of integer values of \( x \) for which the square root of \( x \) is greater than 5 and less than 7.
If $150\%$ of $x$ is equal to $75\%$ of $y$, and $x = 24$, find the value of $y$.

A regular triangular prism \(ABC A_{1}B_{1}C_{1}\) is inscribed in a sphere with the base \(ABC\) and lateral edges \(AA_{1}\), \(BB_{1}\), \(CC_{1}\). The segment \(C_{1}D\) is the diameter of this sphere, and point \(K\) is the midpoint of edge \(CC_{1}\). Find the volume of the prism if \(DK=2\) and \(DA=\sqrt{6}\).
Let \( x \) be the average of the following six numbers: \(\{12, 412, 812, 1212, 1612, 2012\}\). Determine the value of \( x \).

During a certain season, a team won a certain percentage of its first 100 games and 50 percent of its remaining games. If the team won 70 percent of its games for the entire season, what was the percentage of games won in the first 100 games?

Let \(a\), \(b\), \(c\), \(x\), \(y\), \(z\) be nonzero complex numbers such that:
\[

\[
\left(\begin{array}{cccccc}
\left(\sum_{i=1}^n \sum_{j=1}^n c_{ij}\right)^2 & (c_{11} + c_{12} + \cdots + c_{1n})^2 & (c_{21} + c_{22} + \cdots + c_{2n})^2 & \cdots & (c_{n1} + c_{n2} + \cdots + c_{nn})^2 \\
(c_{11} + c_{12} + \cdots + c_{1n})^2 & c_{11}^2 & c_{12}^2 & \cdots & c_{1n}^2 \\
(c_{21} + c_{22} + \cdots + c_{2n})^2 & c_{21}^2 & c_{22}^2 & \cdots & c_{2n}^2 \\
\vdots & \vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\
(c_{n1} + c_{n2} + \cdots + c_{nn})^2 & c_{n1}^2 & c_{n2}^2 & \cdots & c_{nn}^2
\end{array}\right)
\]
